articles.title: Saylor and team overhaul Strategy's bitcoin metrics as bear market persists
articles.snippet: New framework gives common shareholders a clearer view of net bitcoin exposure after preferred stock and convertible debt obligations

articles.title: Brazilian farmers tokenized dairy cows to get loans, bypassing bank lending limits
articles.snippet: Smart collars monitor herd health in real time to prevent fraud, allowing local agricultural businesses to secure thousands in funding backed by livestock.

articles.title: Crypto market maker B2C2 held sale talks with multiple potential buyers
articles.snippet: The SBI-owned crypto trading firm is said to have attracted takeover interest from a number of suitors over the past 18 months, but valuation has been a sticking point.

articles.title: Ripple’s RLUSD gets two boosts as transfer volume drops 25%
articles.snippet: Ripple launched an institutional minting platform and added RLUSD to Notabene’s compliance network as holder growth rose but monthly transfer volume fell to $10.95 billion.

articles.title: Dango’s perp DEX taps out nearly 4 months after launch
articles.snippet: Dango will close its network on Aug. 13, joining BitMEX, Odos and Satori Finance in a wave of recent crypto shutdowns.
